name: War Beast Caretaker
body:
Animals that you train learn to ignore distractions and better resist spells. In the face of strange supernatural opponents, they keep their resolve.

Prerequisite(s): Handle Animal 4 ranks, nature bond (animal companion)

Benefit: With three weeks of training and a successful Handle Animal check (DC 20) you can grant a beast under your tutelage a +2 competence bonus on all saving throws and a +4 competence bonus against mind-affecting attacks and spells.
